resources.label: OpenAI product-design skill patterns
resources.job: reference discovery, design concept generation, implementation routing, and visual QA
resources.licenseBoundary: Use as provenance for workflow design; inspect the source license before copying any code or text.
resources.states: reference, design context, implementation, and visual QA remain separate stages
resources.performance: blocking visual acceptance is reserved for substantial or visually-led work
resources.accessibility: rendered QA still checks keyboard, responsive, fallback, and state behavior
resources.avoid: do not turn concept generation into permission to skip product evidence or live rendering

resources.label: Anthropic frontend-design patterns
resources.job: deliberate frontend aesthetic direction and anti-generic visual decisions
resources.licenseBoundary: Use as provenance for workflow design; inspect the source license before copying any code or text.
resources.states: purpose, audience, direction, type, color, motion, and composition are resolved before polish
resources.performance: prefer one coherent direction over many decorative effects
resources.accessibility: distinctiveness does not replace legibility, semantics, or responsive behavior
resources.avoid: do not equate boldness with oversized type, gradients, glow, or random animation

resources.label: Existing local primitives
resources.job: accessible controls, forms, layout, stateful UI
resources.licenseBoundary: Project-owned; inspect the local repository and its licenses.
resources.states: inherits the project's tested states
resources.performance: lowest incremental cost
resources.accessibility: verify against the local implementation
resources.avoid: do not duplicate an existing primitive just to change its appearance

resources.label: Radix Primitives
resources.job: accessible low-level interaction primitives
resources.licenseBoundary: Confirm the current package license and transitive dependency policy before adding.
resources.states: focus, keyboard, escape, layering, and controlled state require local verification
resources.performance: narrow primitives; audit bundle impact per package
resources.accessibility: strong baseline, not a substitute for product copy or focus review
resources.avoid: do not inherit the demo skin as product identity

resources.label: shadcn/ui source patterns
resources.job: source-owned React component starting points
resources.licenseBoundary: Check the current component and icon licenses before copying source.
resources.states: source ownership makes state extension possible; inspect each component
resources.performance: copy only the needed code
resources.accessibility: verify copied behavior and labels in the target product
resources.avoid: do not install the whole catalog for one missing control

resources.label: Magic UI components
resources.job: copy-adapt animated React components for marketing surfaces and product specimens
resources.licenseBoundary: Inspect the current component, dependency, asset, and icon licenses before copying source into the target project.
resources.states: inspect hover, focus, loading, reduced-motion, and no-JS or static behavior per component
resources.performance: copy only the selected component; measure animation and bundle cost instead of importing the catalog
resources.accessibility: verify keyboard, focus, contrast, touch, and readable final state locally
resources.avoid: do not use the default dark-gradient demo skin as the product's design system

resources.label: Rewamp UI
resources.job: copy-adapt creative React components and present them in a searchable single-specimen workbench
resources.licenseBoundary: Inspect the current component, package, dependency, font, icon, and asset licenses before copying or running its installer; a live source panel is not blanket license proof.
resources.states: exercise the selected component's pointer, touch, keyboard, loading, theme, reduced-motion, cleanup, and static final-state behavior
resources.performance: copy only the selected primitive; measure animation, canvas, pointer listener, GPU, and hydration cost on target desktop and mobile viewports
resources.accessibility: the visual effect cannot be the only signal or path; preserve labels, focus, keyboard, touch, contrast, and a readable static outcome
resources.avoid: do not import a catalog of unrelated effects or inherit the showcase shell as the target product's design system

resources.label: React Bits
resources.job: small React visual primitives for text, cursor, background, scroll, and component interaction
resources.licenseBoundary: Inspect the current source, package, asset, and dependency licenses; demo availability is not license proof.
resources.states: verify pointer, touch, keyboard, reduced-motion, loading, and unmounted cleanup behavior
resources.performance: isolate one effect and measure paint, layout, and event cost on the target viewport
resources.accessibility: the effect must not carry essential information alone and must retain a non-pointer path
resources.avoid: do not combine unrelated effects into an identity or copy demo content as product content

resources.label: Aceternity UI
resources.job: high-impact React/Tailwind landing blocks, hero composition, and bounded scroll visuals
resources.licenseBoundary: Inspect current source, package, asset, font, and dependency licenses before adapting a block.
resources.states: hero and scroll blocks need poster, reduced-motion, mobile, and normal-flow fallbacks
resources.performance: avoid importing a full effects stack; measure GPU, scroll, image, and hydration cost on mobile
resources.accessibility: content and actions must remain available without parallax, hover, or 3D effects
resources.avoid: do not use glow, gradient, or 3D as a substitute for a real product object or proof

resources.label: Obsidian UI
resources.job: interaction-first React components for cursor, hover, scroll, and product-surface polish
resources.licenseBoundary: Inspect the current repository, package, asset, and dependency licenses; verify any copied code independently.
resources.states: pointer, touch, keyboard, reduced-motion, cleanup, and static final-state behavior must be exercised
resources.performance: keep pointer and scroll listeners scoped, passive where appropriate, and removable on unmount
resources.accessibility: every pointer affordance needs a keyboard or touch-equivalent path and visible focus treatment
resources.avoid: do not make a pointer-only effect the only path to a primary action

resources.label: Bencho interaction playground
resources.job: micro-interaction discovery, trigger-response analysis, and polish review
resources.licenseBoundary: Treat the site as interaction research until source and asset rights are separately confirmed; do not copy demos by default.
resources.states: write the trigger, response, duration, final state, keyboard path, touch path, and reduced-motion outcome
resources.performance: prefer CSS or existing local primitives for short feedback; measure pointer and layout work before adding a runtime
resources.accessibility: micro feedback cannot be the only signal; preserve focus, labels, and static final state
resources.avoid: do not install a library or reproduce a playground effect when the missing job is only timing or token polish

resources.label: Design Spells interaction patterns
resources.job: micro-interaction vocabulary and desktop/mobile behavior research
resources.licenseBoundary: A curated example is not code or asset license proof; inspect the original source and create target-owned implementation and media.
resources.states: compare trigger, response, context, mobile/touch equivalent, keyboard path, and final state
resources.performance: use the smallest local or platform mechanism that communicates the pattern
resources.accessibility: verify that motion, hover, and gesture are supplementary rather than required for comprehension
resources.avoid: do not treat a memorable pattern as a requirement when it delays the user's task

resources.label: Lucide
resources.job: coherent interface icons
resources.licenseBoundary: Confirm the current icon and package license; preserve attribution requirements if any.
resources.states: label unfamiliar actions and pair critical icons with text
resources.performance: import only used icons where the framework supports it
resources.accessibility: icons need labels, tooltip text, or visible command text
resources.avoid: do not mix multiple icon families without a deliberate reason

resources.label: TanStack Table
resources.job: table state, sorting, filtering, and row models
resources.licenseBoundary: Confirm current package license and adapter package requirements.
resources.states: empty, loading, sorting, filtering, selection, and pagination remain product-owned
resources.performance: use virtualization only when measured data volume requires it
resources.accessibility: verify keyboard navigation, headers, and responsive table strategy
resources.avoid: do not use a table engine to decide hierarchy or visual semantics

resources.label: View Transition API
resources.job: lightweight route or DOM continuity
resources.licenseBoundary: Platform API; check browser support and compatibility policy.
resources.states: preserve focus and provide a normal navigation fallback
resources.performance: lower dependency cost; measure snapshots on complex layouts
resources.accessibility: honor prefers-reduced-motion and avoid hiding route content
resources.avoid: do not add a generic fade when object continuity is not needed

resources.label: GSAP / ScrollTrigger
resources.job: authored timeline or scroll choreography
resources.licenseBoundary: Confirm the current GSAP licensing and plugin terms for the deployment.
resources.states: kill timelines, clean triggers, and preserve normal document flow
resources.performance: avoid long-running loops and scroll work that blocks input
resources.accessibility: provide reduced-motion and non-scrolling access to content
resources.avoid: do not use it when CSS or native scroll behavior communicates the job

resources.label: model-viewer
resources.job: bounded 3D product inspection
resources.licenseBoundary: Verify package, model, texture, and production asset licenses independently.
resources.states: poster, loading, error, ready, camera bounds, and ordinary controls
resources.performance: defer heavy assets and measure mobile GPU behavior
resources.accessibility: provide alt text, labels, keyboard/touch controls, and a static fallback
resources.avoid: do not use a rotating model as atmosphere

resources.label: Transitions.dev internal bridge
resources.job: named UI transition recipes with Review -> Apply -> Polish
resources.licenseBoundary: The adapter fetches the pinned upstream skill into a private cache; do not redistribute the upstream library.
resources.states: purpose, cleanup, reduced-motion, and static fallback are mandatory
resources.performance: copy only the selected recipe; do not install a motion runtime for CSS recipes
resources.accessibility: preserve final state and focus behavior when motion is disabled
resources.avoid: do not ask the user to install or invoke the upstream skill

resources.label: UI/UX Pro Max capability patterns
resources.job: searchable design intelligence and pre-delivery quality checks
resources.licenseBoundary: Use as provenance for capability design; inspect the source license before copying anything.
resources.states: candidate confidence, anti-patterns, and quality gates remain explicit
resources.performance: local datasets avoid a network call during every decision
resources.accessibility: quality gates include responsive and state evidence
resources.avoid: do not treat a style lookup as product understanding

resources.label: Graphify capability patterns
resources.job: queryable repository structure and dependency context
resources.licenseBoundary: Use as provenance for graph workflow design; inspect the source license before copying anything.
resources.states: unresolved imports and scan truncation remain visible
resources.performance: dependency-free bounded scan; use max-files and max-bytes on large repositories
resources.accessibility: graph output has a compact Markdown path as well as JSON
resources.avoid: do not claim semantic understanding from an import graph alone

resources.label: Caveman capability patterns
resources.job: short, high-signal agent responses with less token waste
resources.licenseBoundary: Use as provenance for response-contract design; inspect the source license before copying anything.
resources.states: Decision, Changed, Proof, and Open are emitted without generic preamble
resources.performance: compact mode limits evidence and output length
resources.accessibility: exact paths and blockers remain readable in plain text
resources.avoid: do not omit uncertainty or proof just to make the response shorter

resources.label: Composio curation capability patterns
resources.job: categorized resource discovery and practical entry points
resources.licenseBoundary: Curated index is provenance, not a license grant for every listed resource.
resources.states: resource job, source type, trust tier, and rejection condition are shown
resources.performance: local catalog avoids dumping an undifferentiated list
resources.accessibility: resource output explains why a candidate was selected
resources.avoid: do not rank by stars or copy a catalog without current API verification

resources.label: VoltAgent curation capability patterns
resources.job: provenance-aware cross-agent skill discovery
resources.licenseBoundary: Curated index is provenance, not a license grant for every listed resource.
resources.states: trust tier and source type remain visible before adoption
resources.performance: select a few candidates instead of returning a giant list
resources.accessibility: catalog records include explicit use and avoid guidance
resources.avoid: do not confuse popularity with compatibility or quality
